description: A level 60 Rogue's gear: full Nightslayer, with Perdition's Blade and Core Hound Tooth for the daggers build and Vis'kag and Brutality Blade -- both already in classic-warrior.json -- for Combat. From two sixtyupgrades.com sets the project owner supplied; the armour is identical between them and only the weapons differ. Season of Discovery items.

items.name: Nightslayer Cover

effects.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.
Improves your chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1%.
(2) Feint also grants Avoidance for 6 sec, reducing all damage taken from area of effect attacks from non-players by 50%.
(4) Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Poisons by 100%.
(6) Your finishing moves have a 5% chance per combo point to make your next ability cost no energy.
